title: Where Mixture Recognition Fails: An Ingredient-Level Audit of Unseen Combinations in SmellNet
abstract: arXiv:2611.19297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An electronic nose must name every ingredient of a mixture, including combinations it has never measured. SmellNet, a public benchmark for this task, scores ingredients with a hit rate that is told how many each sample contains. We audit what this protocol hides. We hold out ingredient combinations from the SmellNet training data, evaluate four architectures (MLP, CNN, LSTM and a Transformer encoder) without revealing the ingredient count, and repeat the evaluation once on the official unseen split. Under the count-informed protocol, 90-96% of mixtures receive an ingredient that is absent, on our folds and on the official split alike. On our folds, every model identifies one ingredient reliably but the second rarely, and it completes the pair with a familiar training partner about twice as often as chance. translated_title: 混合物识别在何处失效：对SmellNet中未见组合的成分级审计
translated_abstract: 电子鼻必须说出混合物中的每一种成分，包括它从未测量过的组合。SmellNet是这一任务的公开基准，它以命中率对成分预测进行评分，并且会告知模型每个样本含有多少种成分。我们审计了这一评估协议所掩盖的问题。我们从SmellNet训练数据中保留成分组合，在不透露成分数量的情况下评估四种架构（MLP、CNN、LSTM和Transformer编码器），并在官方未见划分上重复进行一次评估。在告知成分数量的协议下，无论在我们的数据折上还是官方划分上，90-96%的混合物都被分配了一个实际并不存在的成分。在我们的数据折上，每个模型都能可靠地识别出第一种成分，却很少识别出第二种，并且它会以约两倍于随机水平的概率用一个在训练中熟悉的搭档成分来“补全”这一组合。在官方划分上，即使是排名第一的成分，在二元混合物中也仅有29-46%的判断正确率，而这往往是因为训练集中高频出现的成分被……
tldr: 该研究对SmellNet基准进行了成分级审计，揭示出混合物识别模型在未见成分组合上普遍失效：即便在告知成分数量的宽松协议下，90-96%的混合物仍被预测出实际不存在的成分，且模型倾向于用训练集中的熟悉搭配来“补全”混合物，暴露了嗅觉AI在组合泛化上的严重缺陷。
en_tdlr: An ingredient-level audit of SmellNet exposes severe compositional generalization failures in mixture recognition: even under a count-informed protocol, 90-96% of mixtures receive an absent ingredient, and models complete unseen combinations with familiar training partners rather than true constituents.
